items: Appeals against NGT decisions bypass High Courts and lie directly before the Supreme Court.
Note the 90-day limitation period for filing NGT appeals, a standard question format in environmental law sections.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Appeals challenging the orders of the National Green Tribunal (NGT) are made directly to the Supreme Court of India.
The prescribed timeframe to file an appeal against an NGT order is generally 90 days.
